comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Small rural Alaska utility with large telephone and broadband operations; different mix and remote-community economics from a regulated electric, gas and steam delivery utility.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility; similar regulatory model but different product and not electricity, gas or steam delivery.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Rate-regulated integrated electric and natural gas utility serving residential, commercial and industrial customers; closely matches Con Edison's core electric and gas delivery.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Unregulated upstream gas producer and gas-to-power generator; commodity price exposure, not regulated utility delivery.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Regulated gas and electric distribution utility with pipelines; mostly matches, though propane and marketing add some unregulated exposure.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Regulated water, wastewater and recycled water utility in Arizona; different commodity and growth drivers than electric, gas and steam.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Regulated gas distribution utility serving residential and commercial customers, with clean energy; overlaps Con Edison's gas business and solar investments.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Pure regulated natural gas distribution utility serving residential, commercial and industrial customers; matches Con Edison's gas delivery business.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Unregulated retail propane and fuel oil distributor with truck delivery and HVAC services; not a regulated network utility.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Regulated electric utility holding company with transmission and distribution networks; same business as Con Edison's electric delivery.
